purpose: Visual implementation guide; not a Godot resource file
appearance: fixed dark charcoal with gold historical styling
layout_rule: Treat these as reference proportions. Fit header + map + details within the actual Godot viewport; do not copy 791px total height into a 720px viewport.
font_rule: Use licensed Korean fonts already in the game; serif-style headings and legible body text, without baking text into artwork.
zoom_rule: Calibrate against the existing map transform; browser zoom ratios are not Godot camera ratios.
live_action_rule: Preview first. Reuse existing unit/commander selection and validated dispatch logic for actual orders.
